Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is conducting a procurement to refresh laptops and acquire equipment to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in staff. The scope requires the delivery of 30 units of Dell Latitude 5550 laptops that must be Microsoft Copilot ready, along with 30 units of Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (Model WD22TB4). Additionally, the contractor must provide a 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended for all machines purchased, with a warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award. All products are due by June 10, 2024.
